svg.title: GTT local match viewer: current design, synthetic demo
svg.desc: Midnight-blue viewer, blue home and pink away players, lime ball and dashed player estimates. Every position and label is invented. Sampled animation, not real-match footage.
svg.text: An invented match to explore the viewer.
No real match data is included.
Short gaps ≤ 2 s · long losses fade in 0.6 s
Track slots are not player identities.
Window only · H/A labels, excluding D/X
Synthetic illustration · invented tracking and labels · sampled animation
